action.objective: Commit Bxd7+, the verified knight-winning check that forces the king to recapture, gaining material.
action.rationale: c6d7 is the only commit_ready move and the reserved candidate. Depth-4 exact verification gives 991 with PV c6d7 Nxd7 (or Bxd7) c1b2 O-O. It wins the d7 knight and forces a favorable recapture; safety probe complete, no immediate mate, tactical_refutation not_found. No proven refutations and replan not required. Capturing the knight with check is a concrete material gain and improves development (c1b2 follows). No risk acceptance needed.
